content:
I'll review the puzzle in greater detail tomorrow. A few quick points first:

General
* Why is this Part 1? How many parts will there be, and how will the future parts differ?

Formatting
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly as described in the points below.

Goal
* Please format 7 (in "7x7"), 1, 7 (in "1-7") and all possible tile characters as {{constants}}.

Input
* Please format "Lines 1-7" and "Line 8" in <<bold>>.

Output
* Please format "7 lines" in <<bold>>.

* Please format "#" as a {{constant}}.

Cover picture
* Please add a cover picture for the puzzle.

Thanks.
